requirement.description: The URL.build method has critical implementation issues preventing it from functioning correctly. Many test cases fail at setup stage due to incomplete or incorrect implementation of the build classmethod.
requirement.contract: Implement the URL.build method to correctly construct URLs from individual components (scheme, authority, user, password, host, port, path, query, query_string, fragment) with proper validation and encoding. The method should handle all combinations of parameters correctly, including validation of conflicting parameters and proper encoding of components.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_url_build.py::test_build_with_port[port-str] - Should raise TypeError when port is not an integer

requirement.description: The URL.with_path method has issues with path handling and normalization. The method doesn't properly handle path normalization and validation, causing failures in various path-related tests.
requirement.contract: Implement the URL.with_path method to correctly replace the path component of a URL with proper normalization. The method should handle path encoding, normalization of '.' and '..' segments, and ensure proper path structure (starting with '/' for absolute paths).
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_url.py::test_with_path_keep_query_keep_fragment_flags - Should correctly handle path replacement with query and fragment preservation flags

requirement.description: The URL.with_suffix method has incorrect implementation and validation logic. The method fails to properly validate suffixes and handle path components correctly.
requirement.contract: Implement the URL.with_suffix method to correctly replace the suffix of a URL's path. The method should validate that the suffix starts with a dot, properly handle path encoding, and maintain correct URL structure while preserving query and fragment when requested.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_url.py::test_with_suffix_keep_query_keep_fragment_flags - Should correctly handle suffix replacement with query and fragment preservation flags

requirement.description: The URL.with_name method has incorrect implementation affecting path handling. The method doesn't properly validate name inputs and handle path components correctly.
requirement.contract: Implement the URL.with_name method to correctly replace the name (last part) of a URL's path. The method should validate that the name doesn't contain path separators, handle path encoding properly, and maintain correct URL structure while preserving query and fragment when requested.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_url.py::test_with_name_keep_query_keep_fragment_flags - Should correctly handle name replacement with query and fragment preservation flags

requirement.description: The URL.__new__ constructor has incomplete handling of path processing for relative URLs. This affects the initialization of URLs and causes failures in URL construction.
requirement.contract: Fix the URL.__new__ method to properly initialize URL objects, particularly handling path components for relative URLs. The constructor should correctly process path normalization and ensure consistent caching of URL components.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_url.py::test_parsing_populates_cache - Should correctly populate cache for URL parsing
